items.title: Clorox (CLX) Following First Quarter Results Faces A Pricey Narrative
items.summary: Clorox (CLX) kicked off its fiscal year with first quarter results that caught investor attention. Sales reached US$1,905 million, net income was US$170 million, and diluted EPS from continuing operations came in at US$1.39. Clorox’s latest update lands after a sharp swing in market expectations, with the share price delivering a 27.73% 1 month return and an 8.19% 7 day share price gain, yet longer term total shareholder returns over 3 and 5 years remain negative.
